entities.name: Vladan Đorđević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ipokrat "Vladan" Đorđević was a Serbian politician, diplomat, physician, writer, and organizer of the State Sanitary Service. He held the post of mayor of Belgrade, Minister of Education, Prime Minister of Serbia, Minister of Foreign Affairs and Envoy to Athens and Istanbul.
